name: Parallel_SSHI_FullBridge
rationale: The reference FBR fails in low-excitation (S4) and heavy-load (S2) conditions because the open-circuit voltage peak is too low to overcome the diode drops and reach the 1.8V target. A Parallel SSHI (Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor) is used to flip the voltage across the piezo capacitance (Cp) at the peaks, effectively boosting the voltage available to the rectifier. A DZ33 Zener clamp is added to prevent overvoltage in S3, and a large storage capacitor will be optimized to reduce ripple and improve settling (dv).
